verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm. Controlling retention and deletion of personal data is a fair privacy question for any service that handles sensitive client documents, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only legal services, a newsletter and failed llms.txt/OpenAPI probes, with nothing on data retention, deletion requests or a privacy policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
